contribution_requirements: All existing files must be preserved — only add or extend. Never delete or replace existing Phase 1 files. Each change must leave the codebase in a buildable (tsc --noEmit passes) state.
key_patterns: Backend controllers export named async functions (req, res) => Promise<void>. Routes import named exports from controllers. AuthRequest extends Request adding req.user. Frontend stores use Zustand create() with explicit interface; authStore uses persist middleware. API calls go through apiClient (axios) from src/api/client.ts which reads token from localStorage key 'truckbiz-auth'. Tailwind custom colors: navy-900=#0F172A, navy-800=#1E293B, accent=#F97316, accent-dark=#EA580C. All pages import Layout and wrap content in <Layout>. ProtectedRoute pattern in App.tsx checks useAuthStore(s => s.token).
directory_structure: truckBusinessTrac/ — root with README.md, docker-compose.yml, .gitignore. backend/ — Express API: src/controllers/, src/routes/, src/middleware/, src/index.ts, prisma/schema.prisma, package.json, tsconfig.json. frontend/ — React+Vite: src/pages/, src/components/, src/store/, src/api/, src/App.tsx, src/main.tsx, package.json, tailwind.config.ts, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json. .agents/tasks/ — plan and review artifacts (never inside git worktree commits).
